Those affected are mostly employees of the airport operator Fraport. The Frankfurt Public Health Department believes the outbreak is due to "airport malaria," which occurs when a female Anopheles mosquito carrying the malaria parasite travels by aircraft to a country where the disease is not common from one where it is , bites a person and infects their red blood cells. "We are dealing with a very rare occurrence, not a new frequent disease in Germany," said Achim Hörauf, the director of the Institute for Medical Microbiology, Immunology and Parasitology at Bonn's University Hospital (UKB), in a press release.
